description: January 30 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 2, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a January 30 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the second decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: Personality of a January 30 birthday
paragraphs: January 30 marks the start of Aquarius's second decan, where Mercury, ruler of Gemini, joins the sign's Uranian tone. The Sun is around ten degrees into the sign, and 30 reduces to 3. Language becomes the main tool: a quick, sociable, slightly mischievous communicator, often good at making unusual ideas sound like common sense.

By noon UTC on January 30, the Sun has normally reached roughly 10° of Aquarius. That places the date in the Aquarius decan that astrologers give to Mercury, the second of three. Between 10 and 19 degrees of Aquarius the sub-ruler is Mercury, the ruler of Gemini. Birthdays from around January 30 to February 8 tend to bring a quick, communicative intelligence to the sign's idealism. Natives are often seen as witty, curious and well networked, the kind of person who knows someone in every group and enjoys connecting them. Writing, teaching and technical problem-solving are commonly associated with this decan. Mercury can make the mind race ahead of the body and the heart. Slowing down long enough to listen as well as explain usually deepens their many connections.

sections.heading: Numerology of the January 30 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 30th reduces as 3 + 0 = 3. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 3, so this birthday number carries an extra dose of expression, imagination and social energy. Unlike the 12th or 21st, the compound contains only the 3 itself, which numerologists sometimes describe as creativity without dilution. Thirtieth-born people are frequently described as eloquent, entertaining and quick with ideas. As a secondary number, the 30 tends to shine in writing, speaking or performance. Focus is their usual challenge, since so many ideas compete for attention.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same January 30 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 4 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: January 30 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 30 is the 30th day of the year. In most years Pisces season is under way by February 19, 20 days after this birthday.

January 30 is a date where the Chinese animal genuinely depends on the year. Lunar New Year had arrived by this date in 38 of 121 years between 1924 and 2044; in the others the birth belongs to the previous animal. January 30 is also the birthday of Franklin Delano Roosevelt (1882), Felipe VI of Spain (1968) and Abdullah II of Jordan (1962).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 30?
faq.answer: January 30 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 30?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 30 the Life Path is 11 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 4 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 30th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 30?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology needs care here, because Lunar New Year moves between January 21 and February 20. Across 1924 to 2044 it had passed by January 30 in 38 of 121 years, so the year page for your birth year settles it.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 30?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a January 30 birthday are Franklin Delano Roosevelt (1882), Felipe VI of Spain (1968) and Abdullah II of Jordan (1962). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
